scope: One rehearsal in the room built from the Muse Spark scene spec of the generated living-room image (living_room_pedestal): the user-corrected pedestal (0.30 x 0.28 x 0.90 m, 3 kg) is approached from the door, grasped (IK reach, joints re-anchored to the palms), lifted 10 cm, carried to the requested pose and set down. The approach uses the residual policy of run 20261101T085012 (model_299: 86.3% vs scripted 83.2% on the same 256 starts); the carry uses the residual policy of run 20261101T113949 (variant B: residual 0.7, overspeed 10; 78.9% vs base 71.9%, paired p = 0.004; 3-4 kg 69%). After the carry, a 4 s scripted alignment docks (3 cm / 5 deg) to the root pose that puts the cabinet, as held, at the requested pose; lowering and release keep docking to it. Placement error is measured against the requested pose with the carry tolerance (10 cm / 10 degrees).
